text:
Ana: Heads-up — Xenith onboarding: we've seen 3x tail-latency spikes on LLM endpoint during the P95 window. Customer reported slower returns in the test harness. Looks like a traffic shift with longer contexts. Flagging as a potential renewal risk if not stabilized. Can we propose a short remediation plan? cc: @Sam

ops-bot: Alert: xenith-prod endpoint latency > 1200ms P95 last 2 cycles — runbook https://redwood.internal/runbooks/latency

Sam: I can run a canary swap to `q4_v2` quant model + route 30% traffic to `dedicated-xenith-1` during peak. Baseline: p95=600ms, expected cost delta ~+12%. Need CS approval to schedule with customer.

Mike: Quick sims: `q4_v2` reduces GPU memory ~45% and cuts KV-cache serialize time ~30%. On infra sim, p95 620->420 with batching=4. Worth trying prefix cache + quant.

Lina: Ana — I'll book a 30-min sync with Xenith for tomorrow 10am PT. We'll present the canary plan + ask for a small set of long-context queries for acceptance testing. Acceptance criteria: p95 < 600ms and no quality regressions on eval set.

Ana: SG. Sam — please prepare the canary config snippet and a rollback policy. Include telemetry hooks to mark prompts that regress quality.

Sam: Config snippet:
```
model: redwood/q4_v2-xenith
routing:
  percent: 30
  pool: dedicated-xenith-1
fallback:
  to_model: redwood/q8_0
  on_error: route_all_to_hosted
```
I'll add the eval prompts and auto-fallback if strict quality drop detected.

Mike: Also recommend enabling prefix caching for common templates — smaller change, immediate win, and reduces cost more than the quant swap in some cases.

Lina: I'll draft a customer-facing note with expected wins + safety checklist. Will include pricing impact (~+10%) and the rollback window.

Ana: Good. Renewal in 6 weeks — include this as a mitigant in the renewal playbook. Ping when docs are ready.

Sam: Will push the canary to staging late tonight and post links/logs here. :rocket:

Lina: Thanks — looping in @ops-bot to watch production during canary.

ops-bot: Canary deployment scheduled: xenith-canary-220912 -> monitors enabled.
